steps.title: Locate the birth registration details
steps.description: Find the birth entry number and the Divisional Secretariat where the birth was registered. This information is on the original birth certificate or known to the family.

steps.title: Prepare your National Identity Card (NIC)
steps.description: Bring your valid NIC as proof of identity when applying for the certified copy.

steps.title: Fill the application form (RG Form 2)
steps.description: Complete the application form for a certified copy of birth certificate. State the full name, date of birth, and registration district.

steps.title: Visit the correct Divisional Secretariat
steps.description: Go to the Divisional Secretariat or Registrar General's Department branch where the birth was originally registered. Different districts have different offices.

steps.title: Submit application and pay the fee
steps.description: Submit the completed application form with your NIC. Pay the applicable fee for an ordinary or urgent certified copy.

steps.title: Collect the certified copy
steps.description: Return on the specified date to collect your certified copy of the birth certificate. Urgent copies may be issued the same day for an additional fee.
